question: Asad Ali Khan was known for playing which of the following Indian instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rudra Veena**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Asad Ali Khan**, celebrated for his expertise in playing the** Rudra veena,** an ancient Indian string instrument renowned for its deep resonance, particularly excelled in the **dhrupad style.**
